'''Bro'orvta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war the captain was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], where he trained other [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. He had [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].
